## Goals

-   Learn all the **main elements** that make up the R language
-   Learn the **general logic of programming**, useful with any language
-   Improve the way we approach problems and **make everyday work more efficient**

## How the lessons are organized

-   Theoretical and logical understanding of the topics
-   Understanding code output, error messages and special cases
-   Hands-on practice writing code and solving exercises

## Exam

-   **Format**: The exam will consist of several exercises.
-   **Topics**: The exercises will cover the topics presented during the course.
-   **Allowed material**: You may use the material provided during the lessons. Other online material (or ChatGPT) is not allowed during the exam.
-   **Duration**: 1 hour
-   **Mode**: in class

# Useful links

-   Course Github [**Repository**](https://github.com/arca-dpss/course-R-2425)

-   The book [**Introduction2R**](https://psicostat.github.io/Introduction2R/), available online on Github (in Italian)

-   [**Guide**](https://ottaviae.github.io/test-organizzioni-fisppa/slides/01-IntroR/guida.html){target="_blank"} to installing R and RStudio (in Italian)

-   [Additional exercises by Filippo Gambarota](https://arca-dpss.github.io/course-R/exercises/esercizi-no-solutions.html){target="_blank"} (in Italian)

### Materials in English

-   [**Download R and RStudio**](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/){target="_blank"}: official installation page

-   [**Hands-On Programming with R**](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/){target="_blank"}: a beginner-friendly introduction to programming in R (objects, functions, loops)

-   [**YaRrr! The Pirate's Guide to R**](https://bookdown.org/ndphillips/YaRrr/){target="_blank"}: an introduction to R for psychology students

-   [**Learning Statistics with R**](https://learningstatisticswithr.com/){target="_blank"}: R and statistics for psychology students

-   [**R for Data Science (2e)**](https://r4ds.hadley.nz/){target="_blank"}: importing, tidying, transforming and visualizing data with the tidyverse

-   [**ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis**](https://ggplot2-book.org/){target="_blank"}: the reference book for plotting with ggplot2

-   [**Advanced R**](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/){target="_blank"}: for going deeper into how R works

-   [**An Introduction to R**](https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-intro.html){target="_blank"}: the official manual from CRAN

-   [**Posit Cheatsheets**](https://posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/){target="_blank"}: one-page summaries of the most used packages and of RStudio

**Credits**: Some material has been taken/adapted from materials by [Filippo Gambarota](https://github.com/filippogambarota){target="_blank"} and [Enrico Toffalini](https://github.com/EnricoToffalini){target="_blank"}
